name: connector-whova
description: Whova events / conference-management connector. Read-only over the three objects Whova exposes programmatically — Attendees, Orders, Registrants — each scoped by a required per-tenant Event. Whova publishes no machine-readable API contract and no native third-party REST API; the base URL, auth scheme and per-object paths are resolved at runtime from the credential / CompanyIntegration.Configuration rather than hardcoded, so a live sync requires a credential plus a discovered REST path.
